claims.text: The FDA label says alcohol combined with levocetirizine may further reduce alertness and impair central nervous system performance.
claims.quote: Concurrent use of levocetirizine dihydrochloride with alcohol or other central nervous system depressants should be avoided because additional reductions in alertness and additional impairment of central nervous system performance may occur.

headline.text: The FDA label describes additional impairment of alertness and central nervous system performance with levocetirizine and alcohol.

reported.text: The label describes possible additional impairment when alcohol is combined with levocetirizine.

gaps.text: The packet contains no controlled human study reporting this combination's effects.
searched: (ethanol[tiab] OR alcohol[tiab]) AND "levocetirizine"[tiab] AND (interaction OR coadministration)
